escalations.title: protobufjs Remote Code Execution (CVSS 9.8)
escalations.summary: @opentelemetry/auto-instrumentations-node@0.40.0 pins a vulnerable protobufjs version enabling unauthenticated RCE on portal/Backend

findings.title: UpdateBugInput/UpdateFeatureRequestInput missing blocked_by field
findings.summary: FR-dependency-api-types unimplemented — blocked_by?: string[] absent from shared types, forcing as any cast in DependencyPicker.tsx lines 291 and 293
findings.fix: Add blocked_by?: string[] to UpdateBugInput and UpdateFeatureRequestInput in portal/Shared/api.ts; remove as any casts

findings.title: FR-dependency-seed unimplemented — no portal/Backend seed script
findings.summary: portal/Backend/src/database/seed.ts does not exist; fresh server has no dependency seed data as required by FR-dependency-seed
findings.fix: Create portal/Backend/src/database/seed.ts with dependency seed data per spec

findings.title: Traceability enforcer blind to portal/ and platform/ (85+ FRs unscanned)
findings.summary: tools/traceability-enforcer.py hardcodes source roots to ["Source", "E2E"], making portal/ and platform/ invisible and producing 7 false failures on the dependency-linking plan
findings.fix: Update scanned roots from ["Source", "E2E"] to ["Source", "E2E", "portal", "platform"] and re-triage resulting findings

findings.title: brace-expansion — 4 DoS CVEs via glob patterns
findings.summary: brace-expansion package used in build toolchain has 4 denial-of-service CVEs triggered by pathological glob patterns
findings.fix: Run npm audit fix across affected projects

findings.title: browserslist — memory/crash CVEs (dev environment)
findings.summary: browserslist package has CVEs causing memory corruption/crash; primarily development environment risk
findings.fix: Run npm audit fix; upgrade browserslist to patched version

findings.title: path-to-regexp — ReDoS via route parameters (production)
findings.summary: Express route matching uses path-to-regexp version vulnerable to regular-expression denial-of-service; crafted URL can freeze the Node.js event loop
findings.fix: Upgrade express to latest across all projects; this pulls in a patched path-to-regexp

findings.title: form-data — CRLF injection in multipart fields
findings.summary: form-data package allows CRLF injection via unsanitised multipart field names, enabling header injection attacks
findings.fix: Upgrade express (pulls in fixed form-data) or pin form-data to patched version

findings.title: nanoid — Infinite loop DoS
findings.summary: nanoid package has a vulnerability causing an infinite loop under specific conditions, enabling denial-of-service
findings.fix: Run npm audit fix; upgrade nanoid to patched version

findings.title: @grpc/grpc-js — 2 crash CVEs from malformed messages
findings.summary: Two CVEs allow unauthenticated crash of the gRPC server process via a single malformed packet in portal/Backend
findings.fix: Upgrade @grpc/grpc-js to latest patched version in portal/Backend

findings.title: @opentelemetry/auto-instrumentations-node — Prometheus crash
findings.summary: This package version causes Prometheus metrics endpoint crash; collateral issue from the same version that pins DEP-001

findings.title: @opentelemetry/sdk-node — Prometheus crash (upstream)
findings.summary: Upstream @opentelemetry/sdk-node has a Prometheus crash vulnerability propagated from the auto-instrumentations package

findings.title: portal/Backend: OpenTelemetry stack 2+ major versions behind
findings.summary: portal/Backend's OpenTelemetry dependencies are 2+ major versions behind current stable release, accumulating security debt
findings.fix: Plan and execute full OpenTelemetry migration for portal/Backend (high effort, high priority)

findings.title: uuid: 5 major versions behind
findings.summary: uuid package is 5 major versions behind in portal/Backend and Source/Backend; missing security patches and API improvements
findings.fix: Upgrade uuid to v9+ in both projects; check for API breaking changes in v4→v9

findings.title: pino: 2 major versions behind (Source/Backend)
findings.summary: pino logging library is 2 major versions behind in Source/Backend; missing performance improvements and security patches
findings.fix: Upgrade pino to v9+ in Source/Backend; update log format config if needed

findings.title: React / React-Router: 1 major version behind (Source/Frontend)
findings.summary: React and React-Router are one major version behind in Source/Frontend, missing concurrent features and security patches
findings.fix: Upgrade React and React-Router to latest major; review breaking change guide

findings.title: FR-TMP-001 and FR-TMP-008 missing // Verifies: traceability comments
findings.summary: FR-TMP-001 (risk classification) and FR-TMP-008 (Dockerfile.worker gh+Playwright install) are implemented but lack // Verifies: comments, breaking traceability coverage
findings.fix: Add // Verifies: FR-TMP-001 and // Verifies: FR-TMP-008 at implementation sites

findings.title: Dual logger modules in Source/Backend — ambiguous imports
findings.summary: Source/Backend/src/logger.ts (shim) and Source/Backend/src/utils/logger.ts (canonical) create ambiguous import paths and inconsistent call signatures
findings.fix: Remove logger.ts shim; update all imports to utils/logger.ts; enforce with lint rule

findings.title: Undocumented eslint-disable suppressions in production code
findings.summary: Two eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps suppressions in production code lack documented rationale
findings.fix: Add rationale comments above each suppression, or refactor to eliminate the need for suppression

findings.title: FR-TMP-002 prompt injection guard: comment only, no automated test
findings.summary: FR-TMP-002 E2E prompt injection guard has only a // Verifies: comment — no automated test verifies the prompt template content
findings.fix: Write an automated test that asserts the prompt template content guards against injection
